name: AnyLogic
description: Commercial multi-method simulation software supporting agent-based, discrete-event, and system dynamics modelling within a single Java-based environment. AnyLogic is widely used in supply chain, logistics, healthcare, and urban planning for analysing complex system behaviour under uncertainty.
reputation: Leading commercial simulation platform used in academia and industry; de facto standard for multi-method simulation studies.
notes: Commercial product with a free Personal Learning Edition; not an open benchmark. Model correctness depends on domain expertise and calibration data.
